syrianus-sopater-marcellinus.scholia-eis.edition: Rhetores Graeci, volume IV, Christian Walz, 1833, printed pages 39-846
syrianus-sopater-marcellinus.scholia-eis.evidence: Printed page 39 titles the work Syrianus, Sopater and Marcellinus, Eis staseis tou Hermogenous, and its incipit matches the served opening. Printed page 846 ends Telos ton staseon, matching the served ending. The vendored canon assigns this work tlg2047.tlg001 and identifies the Walz 1833 edition. The separate introduction on printed pages 1-38 is excluded. This is a Work-level identity link, not an assertion that OCR was proofread.
